description: This file defines classes and methods for interfacing with Borland Interbase databases within the ADODB PHP database abstraction library. It extends generic Interbase functionality to support Borland-specific behavior, including transaction handling, server info retrieval, and select limit syntax.

classes.name: ADODB_borland_ibase
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_ibase to implement Borland Interbase specific behavior.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_borland_ibase
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_ibase for record set handling specific to Borland Interbase.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction, handling transaction count and auto-commit settings.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the connected server, including dialect and version.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Implements limit and offset functionality for SELECT queries, adapted for Borland Interbase SQL syntax.

methods.name: ADODB_borland_ibase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Borland Interbase DB class.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_borland_ibase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Borland Interbase record set class.
